description:
A Magical Girl who lost all memories, even of her own
appearance, leaving her form undefined. She wandered
through darkness before reaching the Lighthouse.

An ordinary second-year middle schooler who spends her days happily with loving parents and kindred friends.
Although a bit timid, her gentle, caring nature leads her to extend kindness to all.

A Magical Girl who transfers to Madoka's school.
Amongst other curious behavior, she appears hostile to Mami and Sayaka, but always shows concern for Madoka, regularly offering her advice and kind words.

Mami is a seasoned Magical Girl, having fought Witches since before meeting Madoka and her friends.
Upon learning that Kyubey sees potential in Madoka and Sayaka, she decides to show them the ropes.

Bright, energetic, and with a strong sense of justice, Sayaka admired Mami for protecting others from Witches.
She wished to heal Kyosuke Kamijo, a childhood friend she has feelings for, and uses her magic to help others.

A Magical Girl who's come to take over Mitakihara City following an incident.
She tended to clash with Sayaka, but when she learns that Sayaka also wished to fulfill another's dream, she begins to see her as a comrade.

She once brought hope...and then a curse. Guided by the Law of Cycles, she has come as a messenger to save Homura. She's obsessed with cheese, and the smallest thing can leave her thinking of nothing else.

A Magical Girl who is caught up in a mysterious time loop phenomenon. Mabayu is a third-year student at Mitakihara Middle School and lives with her aunt Sakie above the pastry shop Récompense. She loves watching movies alone, and frequents video rental shops and movie theaters.

Iroha came to Kamihama to decipher her strange dreams.
Kind-hearted, she tends to worry too much about others.
She's a technoklutz and not up on the latest trends.
Usually reserved, she can be a fighter when it counts.

A seasoned Magical Girl who has fought Witches for 7 years in Kamihama.
Yachiyo is well informed about the city and Magical Girls in general.
She keeps her distance from other Magical Girls while she compiles files on Kamihama City's Rumors.

A reckless Magical Girl who's full of energy.
Tsuruno loves her family, especially her grandfather and great-grandfather, who lead the Yuis to their former prosperity.
She fights to become the Mightiest Magical Girl in order to restore the Yui name.

An overly pessimistic Magical Girl. She was rejected by her family and those around her, so she has hardly any self-confidence. However, she'll stand by the people who need her, quietly staying by their side, ready to help them when the time comes.

Felicia is a spirited Magical Girl, full of energy and determination, who hates Witches for taking the lives of her parents.
She now works as a mercenary, hunting Witches all across Kamihama.
Her tough talk hides a kind heart and a love of animals.

Seven years ago, she fought as Yachiyo's partner. After noticing her magic was weakening, she joined the Wings of the Magius as one of their leaders, hoping to secure happiness for herself. Though kind and gentle, her spirit is weak, which leads her to sometimes make bad decisions.

A Magical Girl who is always looking out for rookies.
The middle child, Momoko was influenced by her two brothers' boyishness, but she loves cute, girly things like stuffed animals.
Because she loves cute things she's also a fan of female idols.

A Magical Girl who has trouble opening up to others.
Rena acts cocky to make up for her lack of self-confidence, which leads people who don't know her well to misunderstand her.
She's a picky eater and loves sweets.
She is also a big fan of idols.

A worrywart, Kaede is easily scared.
She is also kind, caring, and ready to take risks for her friends.
She loves animals, plants, and insects, and nature in general.
She enjoys gardening, and though she's not good at them, she likes UFO Catchers.

The "Magical Girl born of Halloween." Or that's what she says at least...
Karin loves reading and drawing manga, she's even created her own Magical Girl story.
She's heavily influenced by her favorite manga, Phantom Thief Magical Kirin.

An assistant Naginata instructor at the Ryushinkan Dojo and Magical Girl.
As the only child of the Dojo Master, she trains hard every day.
She is disciplined, but also absentminded, and that absentmindedness can get her into trouble.

A Magical Girl who is working to create a world without Witches. Touka is the daughter—and former patient—of the director of the Satomi Medical Center, and an astrophysics prodigy. Surrounded by a wall of gadgets and devices, she continues to research her one dream...to know everything about the universe.

A Magical Girl who is working to create a world without Witches. Nemu started writing stories just trying to seek some approval, but it wasn't until she posted those same stories online that she become known as a literary genius. Her dream is to wrap the world in her stories...literally.

A Magical Girl who is trying to create a world where no one has to become a Witch, Alina is an artistic genius obsessed with life and death who pours herself into her work, dreaming of making masterpieces featuring Witches themselves. She's used herself as a subject for her art when in a creative slump.

A Magical Girl who is struggling to figure out what she can do to make everyone happy. She grew up knowing little of the outside, which is why she tries so hard to keep up with others. Skilled at finding the good in people, she dislikes no one. Touka and Nemu are her close friends, and Iroha is her sister.

A Magical Girl whose goal is peace and equality. Altruistic and strong of moral character, her powerful words and demeanor lend her a certain kind of charisma that draws people to her. She devotes herself to her multiple part-time jobs to help support her struggling family.

A Magical Girl who operates as a Coordinator in the outskirts of Kamihama. Unable to fight for herself, she accepts Grief Seeds in exchange for items and providing magical adjustments. Though she usually has a sunny disposition and a friendly smile, very few Magical Girls know her true nature.

Tsukasa's twin sister, Tsukuyo hopes to liberate Magical Girls. Constant training in music, calligraphy, and dance has granted her considerable skills. Though she is admired by her peers, she doesn't have any friends she feels she can open up to. She can only be at peace when she is with her sister Tsukasa.

Tsukuyo's twin sister, Tsukasa hopes to liberate Magical Girls. Born into a family of traditional bamboo craftsmen, she runs the household to support her father and his apprentice. Though she is cheerful and has many friends, Tsukuyo is the only one she can open up to.

An enthusiastic supporter of everyone around her, there isn't a Magical Girl livelier than Natsuki.
She is a huge fan of baseball, and as a cheerleader and the baseball team's manager, she's there for the team year-round.

She may look young but Hinano is a seasoned Magical Girl. She has a mind for science and is president of the chemistry club. Although popular with the younger crowd, she is often made fun of for her childish stature. She strives to be more "mature."

A Magical Girl from the head family of Kashin-ryu, a school of flower arranging started in the Edo period (1603-1868).
Beautiful and impeccable, she appears to be innocent, but she is actually a wise strategist, able to read any situation she is put into with ease.

Emiri strives to be the cutest Magical Girl on earth. She has a distinct way of talking, and likes to give everyone a special nickname. Extremely straightforward, Emiri is very easygoing. Somehow, she can gain the trust of anyone in almost no time.

Kako is a bookworm and the only daughter of the family that runs Natsume Books, a used bookstore in Kamihama.
Her mother is a Japanese teacher. Kako's a softy, never acting selfishly, but that doesn't mean she doesn't make herself completely clear when she has to.

A kung fu master, Meiyui belongs to the Blue Seas Family.
She left her parents in China and came to Japan alone.
She is well-composed, but she lets that all go when it's time to protect her family and townspeople.
She is an excellent Mahjong player.

A Magical Girl who lives in an apartment complex in Daito Ward.
She is cheerful, considerate, and treats everyone with warmth, so people are naturally drawn to her.
Her desire to get along with others can sometimes lead to her kindness being taken advantage of though.

Seika is an introverted Magical Girl who cannot express her feelings well.
She lives in the same apartments as Reira and Mito, and keeps her distance from anyone but them.
People think her to be cold and uninterested, but she secretly has a deep passion for teen dramas.

An innocent and carefree Magical Girl, Mito is not afraid to be herself.
Although she appears to have a relaxed demeanor, there are times when she says things that cut to the core.
Mito lives in the same apartment complex as Reira and Seika, her two childhood friends that she truly treasures.

A Magical Girl who always tries to put on a happy face.
She's lived with her father since her parents divorced when she was young.
Living together has strained their relationship, leading her to become emotionally shut off.

An eccentric, animal-loving Magical Girl who's not much of a people person.
At home and at school, she fell victim to a world that seemed set on crushing her, which fueled her loathing for it.
After making a contract, a certain encounter would lead her down the path towards an even stranger fate.

This Magical Girl knows how to haggle.
Since her mother's passing, she has taken on the responsibility of keeping the household running alongside her father, as the oldest in her family of eight.
But budgeting for a family that big isn't easy, so she's always looking for ways to thrift and save.

A Magical Girl who has been shy since childhood.
Feeling that life was painful, she blamed herself for her loneliness.
It was her fellow Magical Girls that led her out of this despair.
Though she's grown stronger mentally, she still has a timid side.

A Magical Girl raised in an orphanage.
She came from an affluent family, but after her parents died from illness, she went to live in the Azalea House.
A pro at everything she sets her mind to (except cooking...), she helps keep the other orphans in line.

A Magical Girl raised in an orphanage.
The Azalea House took her in after an accident on a family trip claimed her parents.
Despite her tragic childhood, her personality is bright and cheery, and she's talented at getting along with others.

A Magical Girl raised in an orphanage.
She was sent to the Azalea House when her parents abandoned her at the mere age of one year old.
She's simple and direct, and her wild spirit often gets her caught up in all kinds of trouble.

An almost emotionless Magical Girl, Masara was born into a peaceful family and raised by two loving parents.
Despite all the love she was given, she remains cold, living a life lacking excitement.
Deep inside, though, she is thirsty for something more.

A Magical Girl who is into the latest fashion and makeup.
Rika appears to be a typical girly girl, but she is actually very seriously in love. She has been secretly admiring the same person for years.
A genuine person, she gets along with everyone.

Riko is like a little sister to the other Magical Girls.
She often can be found working at her parents' bento shop and is a warming presence for the customers.
Though still quite young, she is considerate to her elders and shows a bravery beyond her age.

A Magical Girl who lives by her daily divinations. If the fortune is good, she's very optimistic. If it's bad, she won't even go out to hunt Witches. She loves fortune-telling, but as her predictions always come true, she's forbidden to do it by other Magical Girls.

An Uwasa who awaited the convergence of four girls at her side so that she could burst into full bloom. She is now able to exit her Rumor thanks to some edits to it, but she lacks common knowledge and others see her as unusual. She always wants to return to her mountain or be with the people she loves.

A Magical Girl often mistaken for a delinquent because of her intense gaze and rough demeanor. Though gentle at heart and fond of plants and animals, trouble always seems to find her, having faced-off against small-time punks and even those from the criminal underworld. Once consumed by distrust, meeting Yachiyo and the others helped her find her faith again.

A Magical Girl from California who is in search of Japanese kawaii culture.
She's obsessed with all things kawaii from Harajuku fashion to anime and manga.
She even uploads videos to show the people back home.
Kumanosuke, the bear plushie she got from her father, is her most precious treasure.

A sleepyhead who always looks ready to start counting sheep—if she can stay awake long enough, that is.
In the daytime, it's a sluggish struggle against the sleepies with her attendance record on the line, threatening to hold her back.
But in the dead of night, her gaze sharpens, and her solemn side awakens to put Witches to rest.

A Magical Girl from medieval France now known as Jeanne d'Arc. After the death of her beloved sister, Catherine, she rose to save a France on the brink of collapse. Simple and trusting, she affectionately calls Cube (Kyubey) "Monsieur Angel."

A cool-headed Magical Girl from medieval Italy who uses shadow magic. In the midst of the Hundred Years' War, she fights alongside Darc and the French army to save France. Though she would never speak of it, she is said to be descended from a famous soldier.

A Magical Girl of medieval France who serves in the war and attends to all of Darc's needs. She is the daughter of Captain "La Hire", who is a comrade-in-arms of Jeanne d'Arc. Though normally a kind and well-mannered girl, her fury cannot be stopped when she becomes angered.

A masked Magical Girl who fights in the shadows for the English in the Hundred Years' War. The second sister of three, and like her mother, adores her family. This love does not spill over to her enemies though. For nothing excites her more than a strong opponent, it's what she lives for.

A blue-blooded Magical Girl whose father is an ex-parliament member.
Oriko does whatever it takes to get the job done, but her strong sense of justice, inherited from her father, keeps her from overdoing it.
She is refined and loves drinking tea at home.

Oriko's loyal servant, Kirika is a dangerous Magical Girl who doesn't hesitate when acting for her queen, no matter how immoral the deed.
She is known as the "Dark Magical Girl," but her mind is pure like a child's. She even has a sweet tooth like one.

A young Magical Girl who is very attached to Kyoko, Yuma sees her as her sister, and is willing to do anything for her.
Although she is an innocent child, she was abused badly, and experiences terror much more distinctly than others, due to that trauma.

A Magical Girl whose life was thrown into disarray by Oriko Mikuni.
She used to live an average life alongside her father who managed a supermarket, her stay-at-home mother, and her straight-laced, fiercely competitive older sister Komaki.
However, her sister's death became the catalyst that drew her into the world of Magical Girls.

A Magical Girl from Toyozuru City who wishes to save many people. She is able to fit in easily with others due to constantly switching schools, but feels that she cannot truly be herself around anyone other than her grandmother. However, through the people she meets, she gradually finds more places where she can be herself. Influenced by her hard-drinking grandmother, she loves strongly flavored bar-style snacks.

A Magical Girl from Toyozuru City who spends her days running around helping people. She once drifted through life lacking both hope and despair, but after a fateful encounter, she found a spark of hope. Though often misunderstood due to her soft-spoken nature, she is earnest and loves cute things. Sumire describes her as "cool yet foolish."

A doll Magical Girl, envisioned as a "What-If" version of one of the Monogatari series heroines. Yotsugi believes her sole mission in life is to defeat Witches. She fights to protect the world and the people dear to her from ruin. Her defining trait is her practically expressionless face.

(C)N/K・A・S

A disorienting Magical Girl, envisioned as a "What-If" version of one of the Monogatari series heroines. Mayoi excels at defense, causing enemy attacks to veer off course as if they've lost their way. For reasons unknown, she is unable to reach her mother's house. Her wish was to go home.

(C)N/K・A・S

An undead Magical Girl, envisioned as a "What-If" version of one of the Monogatari series heroines. Shinobu is a legendary vampire who became a Magical Girl after wishing to die, only for the prey she hunts to become sustenance that extends her life instead. She loves donuts.

(C)N/K・A・S

A Magical Girl in charge of Magia Et Cetera, a comic showcasing the charm and appeal of Magia Exedra. Together with Iroha-chan, she guides the newcomer Name—sometimes with a gentle hand, and other times with...questionable support. She can be found at the Lighthouse, creating new and exciting content for everyone each day.
